name.en-US: The Spirit and Genius of St. Philip Neri
name.pt-BR: O Espírito e o Gênio de S. Filipe Neri

description.en-US: The Spirit and Genius of St. Philip Neri (1850): three lectures delivered in the London Oratory in the triduum before the feast of St. Philip: St. Philip a portrait of Jesus, St. Philip the representative saint of modern times, and St. Philip in England.
description.pt-BR: O Espírito e o Gênio de S. Filipe Neri (1850): três conferências pronunciadas no Oratório de Londres no tríduo anterior à festa de S. Filipe: S. Filipe, retrato de Jesus; S. Filipe, o santo representativo dos tempos modernos; e S. Filipe na Inglaterra.

sources.edition: The Spirit and Genius of St. Philip Neri (London: Henry Lucas, 1850), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The three lectures; the contents is dropped, and the unrelated work bound after them is left out. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1850, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: Lecture I. St. Philip a Portrait of Jesus
Lecture II. St. Philip the Representative Saint of Modern Times
Lecture III. St. Philip in England
